title: The Missing Ledger
author: Casper Fairweather
blurb: Gideon Reyes, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
